hypothesis: Compaction and post-compaction context rebuild clone a large retained entry chain and materialize JSON Value trees; borrowed references, prebuilt summarizer requests, and buffered wire conversion may lower CPU and latency without changing behavior.
approach: Borrow retained entries and context message references, reuse summarizer request bodies for estimation and wire calls, and serialize the pa-core/pa-agent crossing through buffered JSON with the original Value path as a duplicate-key fallback. Modified pa-core session and session_engine compaction/messages modules.
parity_notes: Unit tests compare borrowed vs owned context, prebuilt vs rebuilding estimator, buffered vs Value wire crossing including flattened-rest collisions, non-ASCII/raw blocks, and session rows. Focused tests passed, but no final-head golden compacted-session parity was measured; live full-suite red prevents a parity sign-off. No production PR or merge.
